_doc: Reference airframes for the Phase 1 estimator. Mass excludes the companion computer; compute options add their own mass. Fields marked in 'placeholders' are assumptions, not measurements; replace them with each mission repo's identified values. max_thrust_n is the total thrust of all rotors.

rp1.description: racing-drone's RP-1, an A2RL-class 5-inch racing quadrotor (racing-drone/vehicles/rp1.yaml). Also used for interception until interceptor-drone has its own vehicle.
rp1.source: mass, rotor count, max thrust (4 x 12 N), and quadratic drag from rp1.yaml
placeholders: m: rp1.yaml does not say whether 0.966 kg includes the companion computer; treated as excluding it
max_thrust_n and drag_coefficient are rp1.yaml placeholders

scout-0.9kg.description: Scout class, Mavic 3 size (paper Table III). scout-drone has no airframe of its own yet.
scout-0.9kg.source: mass, propeller, battery, and area from the paper's Table III (DJI Mavic 3)

inspection-small.description: Small inspection class, Skydio 2 size (paper Table III).
inspection-small.source: mass, propeller, battery, and area from the paper's Table III (Skydio 2)

inspection-heavy.description: Heavy inspection class, Matrice 200 size (paper Table III).
inspection-heavy.source: mass, propeller, battery, and area from the paper's Table III (DJI Matrice 200)
